identificationModule.briefTitle: Study Assessing the Efficacy and Safety of Alpelisib Plus Fulvestrant in Men and Postmenopausal Women With Advanced Breast Cancer Which Progressed on or After Aromatase Inhibitor Treatment.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized Double-blind, Placebo Controlled Study of Alpelisib in Combination With Fulvestrant for Men and Postmenopausal Women With Hormone Receptor Positive, HER2-negative Advanced Breast Cancer Which Progressed on or After Aromatase Inhibitor Treatment

armGroups.label: Fulvestrant + alpelisib
armGroups.description: Subjects treated with alpelisib (300 mg; oral; once daily) in combination with fulvestrant (500 mg; intramuscular injection on Day 1 and Day 15 of Cycle 1, and then Day 1 of each subsequent 28-day cycle)

armGroups.label: Fulvestrant + placebo
armGroups.description: Subjects were treated with placebo (300 mg; oral; once daily) in combination with fulvestrant (500 mg; intramuscular injection on Day 1 and Day 15 of Cycle 1, and then Day 1 of each subsequent 28-day cycle)

interventions.name: Fulvestrant
interventions.description: 500 mg of fulvestrant administered via intramuscular injection on Day 1 and Day 15 of Cycle 1, and then Day 1 of each subsequent 28-day cycle

interventions.name: Alpelisib
interventions.description: 300 mg of alpelisib tablets for oral use administered once daily

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: 300 mg of placebo tablets for oral use administered once daily
